name: Binance BTC/USDT one-, five- and fifteen-minute price Z-score
description: A causal reading over the fresh Binance `btcusdt@bookTicker` displayed best-quote midpoint, sampled once per second on the lane decision clock. Each field is the current one-second sample minus the arithmetic mean of the window, divided by the population standard deviation of the same window, over the trailing sixty, three hundred and nine hundred one-second samples respectively. sample_count is the number of contiguous one-second samples behind the reading, capped at the longest window. A window whose standard deviation is exactly zero has no defined score: the identity publishes no value and carries the `flat_window` reason until the next sample moves the window. The three windows are initial research defaults that require empirical calibration; the standardisation formula is not a heuristic threshold. A missing or non-ready one-second sample breaks continuity: the sample ring is discarded and the warm-up restarts. Nothing is bridged across a gap. Ready once nine hundred contiguous one-second samples have been observed; each window is the trailing w samples up to and including the current one. Decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even. Every reading is causal: it reads only samples at or before the decision it is published on. E47 (USD quoting): this identity quotes in USD and publishes no price, notional or quote-denominated cost field — its outputs are basis-point ratios, indices, counts and timestamps, which are quote-currency neutral — so nothing is converted and no usdt_usd_rate is published. quote_currency is the constant "usd". Binance inputs are rights-gated (`signals/knowledge/RIGHTS-LEDGER.md`): the lane is built and tested to the adopted standard, and its runtime refuses to start unless the environment allow-list `SIGNALS_ENABLED_VENUES` names `binance`. Adopted in the C3a TA pack (ruling E51, 2026-09-04): the seven technical-analysis identities are published on every price venue we carry, computed from the venue's own one-second sample ring by the shared `crates/btc-signals/src/ta.rs` helper, so every scope runs byte-identical arithmetic and only the sample series differs.
